properties.name: Techno Gamerz High-Speed 3-Star Police Chase & Bhasad Reaction
spoken_exclamations: Arre bhai bhai police aa gayi!
Bhasad mach gayi poori city mein!
Peeche dekho cop car aa rahi hai!
Ye shortcut se nikalte hain!
Oye hoye kya drift maari bhai!
visual_traits: techno gamerz webcam facecam showing mouth open wide in energetic shock
red and blue police siren reflections flashing across sports car body
high speed tactical drift around vice city intersection dodging cruisers
active minimap displaying three flashing wanted stars
properties.hud_trigger_rule: Creator webcam detected + 3 wanted stars + Hindi acoustic RMS > 0.40

properties.name: Supermarket Gun Loot & Cash Register Robbery in Hindi
spoken_exclamations: Chal hath upar kar jaldi!
Saara cash bag mein bhar!
Police ko phone mat karna!
Jaldi bhag muscle car start kar!
Loot liya bhai poora store!
visual_traits: lucia pointing black pistol at convenience store shopkeeper
cashier hurriedly throwing paper currency stacks into duffel bag
glass door kicking open with glass reflection of city traffic
muscle car burnout getaway tire smoke in parking lot
properties.hud_trigger_rule: Weapon reticle aimed + cash register drawer open + rapid sprint

properties.name: Extreme 150 MPH Gadi Ka Kachra Car Crash Deformation
spoken_exclamations: Arre gadi ka kachra ho gaya!
Ye kya physics banayi hai Rockstar ne!
Chithde udd gaye car ke!
Engine hi bahar nikal gaya yaar!
150 ki speed pe seedha deewar mein!
visual_traits: high speed sports car head on collision folding front hood like paper
sparks showering as bare metal alloy wheel grinds against asphalt
radiator steam cloud billowing upwards across camera view
streamer facecam laughing hysterically pointing at vehicle wreckage
properties.hud_trigger_rule: Abrupt velocity drop > 45 px/frame + metallic crunch audio spike

properties.name: Vice City Sunset & Ocean Drive Graphics Shock in Hindi
spoken_exclamations: Bhai ye graphics dekho ek baar!
Paani ka reflection dekho asli lag raha hai!
Vice City kitna sundar banaya hai!
Next-gen lighting ka kamaal hai bhai!
Rockstar ne dil jeet liya!
visual_traits: luxury convertible cruising down ocean drive flanked by vibrant palm trees
ray traced sunset water reflections on coastal road and yacht harbor
warm orange and magenta sunset glow bathing skyscrapers
streamer facecam expressing genuine awe and clapping hands
properties.hud_trigger_rule: Ocean Drive landmark + volumetric lighting + facecam active

properties.name: CarryMinati High-Energy Heist Shootout & Ranting Reaction
spoken_exclamations: Kaha se goli maar rahe ho be!
Ruk tera abhi intezaam karta hu!
Abe cover lo jaldi!
Headshot mara seedha!
Aisi taisi kar di inki!
visual_traits: carryminati facecam screaming into studio condenser microphone
assault rifle muzzle flashes firing rapidly from concrete pillar cover
bullet impact sparks and concrete chips flying off wall surface
red damage vignette flashing at screen edges indicating low health
properties.hud_trigger_rule: Continuous weapon muzzle flash + damage vignette + acoustic loudness > -6dB

properties.name: Swamp Airboat Drifting & Alligator (Magarmacch) Attack in Hindi
spoken_exclamations: Arre magarmacch aa gaya bachao!
Gator ne gadi pe hamla kar diya!
Ye daldal mein phas gaye bhai!
Airboat ko full speed pe bhagao!
Mud physics dekho kitna asli hai!
visual_traits: swamp airboat drifting sideways spraying mud and marsh water
large alligator snapping jaws near water edge of Everglades swamp
dense tropical wetlands vegetation flexing under vehicle momentum
streamer jumping out of chair in surprise
properties.hud_trigger_rule: Airboat wake particles + animal entity bounding box + streamer reaction
